name: Semaglutide
saltNote: Free-peptide MW listed; no salt (contains its own C18 diacid + linker). Not a simple acetate salt product.
notes: GLP-1 analog with an AEEA-AEEA-γGlu spacer and C18 fatty diacid on Lys26. MW is NOT the bare-sequence sum — use published value. PubChem lists avg MW as ~4114.

name: Tirzepatide
saltNote: Free-peptide MW; carries its own C20 diacid + γGlu-AEEA linker (not a simple salt).
notes: Dual GIP/GLP-1 agonist, 39 aa with Aib at positions 2 & 13 and a C20 fatty-diacid conjugate. Published MW ~4813; sequence-sum invalid.

name: Retatrutide
saltNote: Free-peptide MW (PubChem CID 171390338). A sodium-salt CID also exists.
notes: Triple agonist, 39 aa, Aib + C20 diacid conjugate. SOURCE CONFLICT: some peptide vendors list C228H350N48O66 / ~4894 Da; PubChem's C221H342N46O68 / 4731 is used here as authoritative.

name: Cagrilintide
saltNote: Free-peptide MW; an acetate-salt CID (164618153) also exists.
notes: Long-acting amylin analog, disulfide-cyclized, C-terminal amide, di-acid lipidation. Modified — use published MW.

name: Liraglutide
saltNote: Free-peptide MW; palmitoyl-γGlu chain is part of the molecule.
notes: GLP-1 analog with a C16 palmitoyl chain via γ-Glu on Lys26. Modified — published MW ~3751.

name: BPC-157
saltNote: Commonly supplied as acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: Synthetic pentadecapeptide (partial sequence of gastric protein BPC). Unmodified linear peptide — sequence-sum matches published MW. 'BPC-157 arginate' salt variants exist at different MW.

name: TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4)
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: N-terminally acetylated 43-aa protein (full Tβ4). CAUTION: 'TB-500' is marketed ambiguously — sometimes the full Tβ4 (MW ~4963, listed here) and sometimes only the active fragment Ac-LKKTETQ (~889 Da). Verify which the COA describes.

name: GHK-Cu (Copper Peptide)
saltNote: 1:1 copper(II) complex of the GHK tripeptide. Free (metal-free) GHK peptide is C14H24N6O4, MW 340.38.
notes: Copper-bound tripeptide (Gly-His-Lys:Cu). Modified/complexed — MW depends on copper stoichiometry & protonation state; several PubChem CIDs exist (neutral complex ~401.9, protonated forms ~402.9). Free GHK = 340.38.

name: Ipamorelin
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: Aib-His-D-2-Nal-D-Phe-Lys-NH2. Contains Aib, D-amino acids, 2-naphthylalanine and a C-terminal amide — non-standard residues, use published MW.

name: CJC-1295 without DAC (Mod GRF 1-29)
saltNote: Commonly acetate/TFA salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: Tetra-substituted GRF(1-29) (D-Ala2, Gln8, Ala15, Leu27) with C-terminal amide, NO drug-affinity-complex (DAC). Do not confuse with the DAC version (higher MW). Widely cited 3367.9 Da.

name: CJC-1295 with DAC (DAC:GRF)
saltNote: Commonly acetate/TFA salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: Mod GRF(1-29) plus a Lys-maleimidopropionyl drug-affinity-complex that binds serum albumin (weekly dosing). SOURCE CONFLICT: many vendors/ChemSpider/Wikipedia mislabel C152H252N44O42 / 3367.9 as 'with DAC' — that formula is actually the NO-DAC version. PubChem's C165H269N47O46 / ~3647 used here as the DAC molecule.

name: Sermorelin
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: Native GHRH first 29 residues with C-terminal amide (modified terminus). Published MW ~3358.

name: Tesamorelin
saltNote: Acetate salt product carries ~7 acetate counter-ions (~5135.9 for the acetate); free-peptide MW listed here.
notes: GHRH(1-44) analog with an N-terminal trans-3-hexenoyl group. Modified — use published MW (~5136 free / ~5135.9 acetate).

name: Hexarelin
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: His-D-2-methyl-Trp-Ala-Trp-D-Phe-Lys-NH2. Contains 2-methyl-Trp, D-residues, C-terminal amide — use published MW.

name: MK-677 (Ibutamoren)
saltNote: Sold as ibutamoren mesylate; free-base MW listed (mesylate salt adds ~96 for CH4O3S).
notes: NOT a peptide — a small-molecule ghrelin-receptor agonist / GH secretagogue. Real MW given for identity check.

name: PT-141 (Bremelanotide)
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: Cyclic 7-residue melanocortin (MC3R/MC4R) agonist, lactam-cyclized, contains Nle & D-Phe. Modified — use published MW.

name: Melanotan I (Afamelanotide)
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: [Nle4, D-Phe7]-α-MSH, linear 13-mer, N-acetyl + C-terminal amide, Nle and D-Phe. Modified — use published MW.

name: Melanotan II
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: Cyclic lactam melanocortin agonist, Ac-Nle-cyclo(Asp-His-D-Phe-Arg-Trp-Lys)-NH2. Modified — use published MW.

name: Selank
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: Tuftsin analog heptapeptide (Thr-Lys-Pro-Arg-Pro-Gly-Pro). Linear unmodified — sequence-sum matches published MW.

name: Semax
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: ACTH(4-7) + Pro-Gly-Pro (Met-Glu-His-Phe-Pro-Gly-Pro). Linear unmodified — sequence-sum matches published MW.

name: DSIP (Delta Sleep-Inducing Peptide)
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: Nonapeptide Trp-Ala-Gly-Gly-Asp-Ala-Ser-Gly-Glu. Linear unmodified — sequence-sum matches published MW.

name: Epithalon (Epitalon)
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: Tetrapeptide Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly. Linear unmodified — sequence-sum matches published MW.

name: Oxytocin
saltNote: Often supplied as acetate; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: Cyclic nonapeptide with an intramolecular disulfide (Cys1-Cys6) and C-terminal amide (Gly-NH2). Modified — use published MW; disulfide means -2 H vs reduced form.

name: HCG (Human Chorionic Gonadotropin)
saltNote: Biologic; not a salt-form small peptide.
typicalHplcSpec: Potency in IU; not a simple HPLC purity spec
notes: MW intentionally null. Heterodimeric glycoprotein (α 92 aa + β 145 aa) that is heavily glycosylated — apparent MW ~36,000–40,000 Da varies with glycoform. No single exact small-molecule MW; identity is by IU potency/immunoassay, not MW.

name: NAD+ (Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide)
saltNote: Often supplied as free acid or disodium salt; free-acid MW listed.
notes: NOT a peptide — a dinucleotide coenzyme. Real MW given for identity check (oxidized NAD+ form).

name: SS-31 (Elamipretide)
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: D-Arg-Dmt-Lys-Phe-NH2. Contains 2,6-dimethyltyrosine (Dmt), a D-residue and a C-terminal amide. Modified — use published MW.

name: AOD-9604
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: hGH(177-191) with an N-terminal Tyr added; intramolecular disulfide (Cys-Cys). Modified — use published MW.

name: HGH Fragment 176-191
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: CAUTION/overlap: research-market 'HGH Fragment 176-191' is essentially AOD-9604 (Tyr-modified, disulfide), MW ~1815. A true native Phe-176 fragment (no added Tyr) would differ slightly (~1817 with Phe vs Tyr). Verify vendor sequence against the COA.

name: Thymosin Alpha-1
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: N-terminally acetylated 28-residue peptide. Modified terminus — use published MW (~3108).

name: Thymalin
saltNote: Biologic extract; not a single defined salt-form.
notes: MW intentionally null. Thymalin is a POLYPEPTIDE FRACTION extracted from calf thymus — a mixture of peptides, not a single molecule, so no single MW applies. Note: some vendors sell a synthetic dipeptide (Glu-Trp / 'thymogen') under confusingly similar names — verify.

name: Kisspeptin-10
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: C-terminal 10-mer of kisspeptin (Tyr-Asn-Trp-Asn-Ser-Phe-Gly-Leu-Arg-Phe-NH2) with a C-terminal amide. Modified terminus — use published MW.

name: Gonadorelin (GnRH)
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: Native GnRH decapeptide with N-terminal pyroglutamate and C-terminal Gly-amide. Modified termini — use published MW.

name: Triptorelin
saltNote: Commonly acetate or pamoate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: GnRH agonist with D-Trp6, N-terminal pyroglutamate and C-terminal Gly-amide. Modified — use published MW.

name: LL-37
saltNote: Commonly acetate or TFA salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: 37-residue human cathelicidin antimicrobial peptide. Linear unmodified — sequence-sum matches published MW.

name: KPV
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: C-terminal tripeptide of α-MSH (Lys-Pro-Val). Linear free-acid form — sequence-sum matches published MW. (Some products are C-terminal amide, which would be ~1 Da lower.)

name: ARA-290 (Cibinetide)
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: 11-residue erythropoietin-derived helix-B peptide (Gln-Glu-Gln-Leu-Glu-Arg-Ala-Leu-Asn-Ser-Ser). Linear — sequence-sum aligns with published MW.

name: MOTS-c
aliases: Mitochondrial ORF of the 12S rRNA type-c
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: 16-residue mitochondrial-derived peptide. Linear — sequence-sum matches published MW (contains 2 Met).

name: Humanin
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: 24-residue mitochondrial-derived cytoprotective peptide. Value here is wild-type humanin. NOTE: the common 'HNG' analog (S14G) has a different MW — verify which variant the COA describes.

name: SNAP-8 (Acetyl Octapeptide-3)
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: Ac-Glu-Glu-Met-Gln-Arg-Arg-Ala-Asp-NH2 (N-acetyl + C-amide). Modified — use published MW. SOURCE NOTE: some vendors cite 1075.2; PubChem's 1073.2 used here.

name: GHRP-2
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: D-Ala-D-2-Nal-Ala-Trp-D-Phe-Lys-NH2. Contains D-residues, 2-naphthylalanine, C-terminal amide. Modified — use published MW.

name: GHRP-6
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: His-D-Trp-Ala-Trp-D-Phe-Lys-NH2. Contains D-residues and C-terminal amide. Modified — use published MW.

name: IGF-1 LR3 (Long R3 IGF-1)
saltNote: Recombinant protein; not a small-molecule salt form.
notes: MW intentionally null due to SOURCE CONFLICT: an 83-residue recombinant IGF-1 analog (13-aa N-terminal extension + Glu3→Arg). Vendors cite ~9111, ~9117.8, and ~9200 Da inconsistently. A 3-disulfide protein — identity is by mass-spec/SDS-PAGE, not a single agreed small-molecule MW. Approx ~9.1 kDa.

name: Follistatin-344
saltNote: Recombinant glycoprotein; not a small-molecule salt form.
notes: MW intentionally null. 344-residue glycoprotein isoform of follistatin (~37.8 kDa core, higher glycosylated). A full protein, not a defined-MW peptide — identity by SDS-PAGE/immunoassay. Also sold as FST-315 (different isoform).

name: Tesofensine
saltNote: Studied as tesofensine citrate; free-base MW listed (citrate salt is markedly heavier).
notes: NOT a peptide — a small-molecule triple monoamine (SNDRI) reuptake inhibitor. Free-base formula/MW given for identity check (contains 3,4-dichlorophenyl).

name: 5-Amino-1MQ
saltNote: The active species is the 1-methylquinolinium CATION; commonly supplied as the iodide salt (C10H11N2I, ~286.1). Cation MW listed.
notes: NOT a peptide — a small-molecule NNMT inhibitor (quaternary quinolinium cation). Identity check should account for whether the COA reports the cation (~159) or a salt (e.g. iodide ~286).

name: Argireline (Acetyl Hexapeptide-8)
saltNote: Commonly acetate salt; free-peptide MW listed.
notes: Ac-Glu-Glu-Met-Gln-Arg-Arg-NH2 (N-acetyl + C-amide). Modified — use published MW. Parent hexapeptide of SNAP-8.

name: Glutathione (reduced, GSH)
saltNote: Usually supplied as free acid (reduced form); free-acid MW listed.
notes: Tripeptide but with a NON-standard γ-glutamyl bond (Glu side-chain to Cys), so a normal α-peptide sequence-sum tool would mis-model it — flagged modified. Value is the reduced (GSH) form; oxidized GSSG is ~612.

name: Survodutide
saltNote: Free-peptide MW; carries its own fatty-acid/linker (not a simple salt).
notes: GCGR/GLP-1R dual agonist with Aib and a lipid side chain. Modified — use published MW (~4231).

name: Mazdutide
saltNote: Free-peptide MW; oxyntomodulin-based, carries its own fatty diacid (not a simple salt).
notes: Oxyntomodulin analog (GLP-1/glucagon) with C20 diacid lipidation. Modified — use published MW (~4474).

name: Dihexa
saltNote: Usually supplied as free base/acid; MW listed as neutral.
notes: Angiotensin-IV-derived: N-hexanoyl-Tyr-Ile-(6-aminohexanoyl) amide. Heavily modified (non-standard acyl caps, amide) — sequence-sum invalid, use published MW.
